sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((e.properties ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((e.properties ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END > $4::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((e.properties ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((e.properties ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END < $4::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((e.properties ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((e.properties ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END <@ tstzrange($4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz, '[)')), false) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((e.properties ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((e.properties ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END <= $6::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((e.properties ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((e.properties ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END <@ tstzrange($7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, '(]')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((e.properties ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((e.properties ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END <@ tstzrange($8::timestamptz, $9::timestamptz, '[)')), false)))
